summary: The fund, an actively-managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”), seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in U.S. large capitalization equity securities. Under normal market circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (including any borrowings for investment purposes) in large-cap U.S. companies. The fund's managers consider large-cap U.S. companies to be those companies with a market capitalization of greater than $10 billion or more.
